variants.when: H2 (for example 2006): accelerator pedal method, with or without the Driver Information Center
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the key to RUN with the engine off.
Slowly push the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up three times within five seconds.
OIL LIFE RESET should flash for about 10 seconds while the system resets.
Turn the key to LOCK. If CHANGE ENGINE OIL comes back at the next start, repeat the steps.

variants.when: H3 (for example 2007): instrument cluster reset stem
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the engine off, turn the key to On.
Press and release the reset stem until OIL LIFE shows.
When OIL LIFE and RESET take turns on the display, press and hold the stem until several beeps sound.

variants.when: H3 with a low tire pressure light (for example 2007)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the Tire and Loading Information label on the driver's door.
There is no reset button. The light stays on until the pressure is corrected, then goes off on its own.
Clearing the CHECK TIRE PRESSURE message only hides it until the next start if a tire is still low.

notes: Hummer used the GM Oil Life System. The H2 resets with the accelerator pedal method and the H3 with the reset stem on the instrument cluster.
